article.story: DAVIDSON, N.C. -- — Hunter Adam's 14 points off the bench helped Davidson to an 85-69 victory over Washington State on Friday. Adam shot 4 for 5 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Wildcats (2-0). Sam Brown scored 12 points and Devin Brown had 11 points. Emmanuel Ugbo finished with 16 points for the Cougars (0-2). Davidson took the lead with 19:41 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Adam led their team in scoring with nine points in the first half to help put them up 40-24 at the break. Davidson closed out the victory over Washington State in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
